title: Pear game package manifest (pear-game.json)
description: What a game declares beside its scene and scripts. Documentation and editor support only: Web/packages/pear-runtime/src/manifest.ts and Backend/src/manifest.rs are the validators and apply these same rules. Unknown fields are kept, never rejected.

scene.description: Path of the scene file inside the package; relative, no '..'. Default scene.json.

scripts.description: Script names the package ships; each must also be listed in the scene. Default: the scene's own lists.

raise.description: Raise when the gravity direction is angleDeg away from rest; lower again at angleDeg - hysteresisDeg.

controller.description: Reserved for the data-driven phone controller; kept as written.

cues.description: Reserved for named sound and haptic cues; kept as written.

instructions.description: Game instructions in the shape the Studio Instructions panel saves.

checks.description: Path of the check spec inside the package; relative, no '..'.
